channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: Cyber Chaos Monkey: Staying ahead of security threats with AI agents
item.description: How we pair AI agents with our knowledge of Shopify’s systems to safely attack our production infrastructure, find bugs, and reduce risks.

item.title: Test your applications against AWS locally with AWS Emulator
item.description: AWS Emulator is a free, open-source local emulator in Rust that lets developers test applications against nearly every AWS service on their own machine using the same CLI and SDK commands, with fidelity measured against real AWS behavior.

item.title: Shopify’s generative discovery model
item.description: How we train and serve a shared generative model for personalized search and recommendation at Shopify scale.

item.title: Intelligent Delivery: Making Every Unit of Compute Serve Better Ads
item.description: Ads ranking models are growing toward LLM scale faster than the hardware to run them can keep up An extra unit of compute has more impact on some ad requests, models, and chips than on others The post Intelligent Delivery: Making Every Unit of Compute Serve Better Ads appeared first on Engineering at Meta.
